function hash(text) {
  var result = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < text.length; i++) {
    result = ((result << 5) - result + text.charCodeAt(i)) | 0;
  }
  return result >>> 0;
}
function classify(value) {
  switch (typeof value) {
    case 'number':
      return value !== value ? 'NaN' : 'number';
    case 'string':
      return /^\d+$/.test(value) ? 'numeric string' : 'text';
    case 'undefined':
      return 'missing';
    default:
      return 'other';
  }
}
function requireNumber(value) {
  if (typeof value !== 'number') throw 'Expected a number';
  return value;
}
console.log(hash('rell-vm'));
console.log(classify('123'));
console.log(classify('hello'));
console.log(classify(NaN));

console.log(typeof requireNumber);
console.log(requireNumber(42));
var value = {
  valueOf: function () {
    return 7;
  },
};
console.log(value + 5);
console.log(value == '7');
console.log(value !== 7);
var bits = 12;
bits ^= 5;
bits <<= 1;

console.log(delete object.remove);
console.log('remove' in object);
console.log('keep' in object);

var count = 0;
console.log(void count++);
console.log(count);
var result = '';
for (var index = 0; index < 4; index++) {
  switch (index) {
    case 1:
      continue;
    case 2:
      result += 'two';
      break;
    default:
      result += index;
  }
  result += '|';
}
debugger;
console.log(result);
